name: @bear-harness/desktop
description: Bear Harness desktop app — SolidJS renderer on an Electron shell.
author: fltb

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.package:mac:arm64: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/stage-native-bindings.mjs darwin arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/stage-native-bindings.mjs darwin x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg zip --x64
scripts.package:win: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/stage-windows-runtime.mjs && node scripts/stage-native-bindings.mjs win32 x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/stage-native-bindings.mjs linux x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux AppImage deb --x64
